textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® E3900 (“Apollo Lake-I”)

The MBox-Advanced, a robust Embedded BoxPC, is powered by Intel Atom E3900 (Apollo Lake-I) processors, catering to diverse embedded applications. This compact yet powerful device boasts four independent Gigabit Ethernet ports, including TSN capability, ensuring high data throughput and versatility. It also supports DP++ for high-resolution monitor connections, ideal for a range of industrial applications.

Security-conscious users will appreciate the AES-NI support and optional TPM 1.2/2.0 features, enhancing data protection and system security. For deployments in demanding environments, an optional extended temperature support option is available.

The MBox-Advanced's compact design and customizable configurations make it a versatile choice for industrial applications, including serving as an industrial firewall or security appliance. It partners with Intel, utilizing Intel i210 Ethernet controllers for optimal performance.

With a focus on reliability and longevity, the MBox-Advanced is designed for industrial use, offering extended lifecycle support of over 10 years. Its robust construction and advanced features make it an excellent choice for FPGA engineers seeking dependable solutions for their embedded systems.

text.text:
Features

  • Four Independent Gigabit Ethernet Ports: The MBox-Advanced provides four Ethernet ports, each capable of Gigabit speeds, with support for Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) for high data throughput.
  • High-Resolution Monitor Support: With DP++ compatibility, this device allows for high-resolution monitor connections, making it suitable for various industrial applications requiring quality display output.
  • Advanced Security Features: AES-NI support and optional TPM 1.2/2.0 features enhance data protection and system security, ensuring the integrity of critical information.
  • Extended Temperature Support: The optional extended temperature support makes the MBox-Advanced suitable for deployments in demanding environments with fluctuating temperature conditions.
  • Custom Configurations and ODM Branding: This device offers flexibility with custom configurations, allowing users to tailor it to their specific needs. Additionally, it supports ODM branding for a personalized touch in industrial settings.

CPU
  • Intel Atom® x5/x7 E3900 (Apollo Lake-I)
  • x7-E3950 4x 1.6/2.0 GHz, 12 W
  • x5-E3940 4x 1.6/1.8 GHz, 9.5 W
  • x5-E3930 2x 1.3/1.8 GHz, 6.5 W
Memory
  • DDR3L - 2-4-8 GB
Graphics
  • 1x DisplayPort (DP++) with up to 4K UHD resolution
Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 4x Gigabit Ethernet (Intel i210)
  • USB - 2x USB 3.0 | 1x USB 2.0
  • Serial Ports - 1x RS-232
Other Interfaces
  • M.2 -  1x M.2 2242/2280 (key B+M) socket (SATA+USB) (8 GB up to 512 GB MLC, SLC/SuperMLC on request)
General
  • Dimensions - 170mm x 103mm x 42mm
  • Temperature range - Standard temperature: 0°C…+60°C
  • Power supply - 9 V - 36 V / Connector type: Phoenix MC1,5/2-G-3,5
  • Power consumption - typ. 3 - 10 W/max. 15 W
OS
  • Windows 10 (Standard and Embedded/IoT)
  • Linux (e.g. Ubuntu)
  • Others on request
  • Custom specific software images can be pre-installed.
